coverage_notes: [landline-telcos] Roster basis: all 1,459 USAC ILEC study areas (high-cost 2025-26 + Lifeline listings) grouped into ~930 billing companies; Bell/large holding companies (AT&T, Verizon, CenturyLink/Lumen, Brightspeed, Frontier, Kinetic/Windstream, Consolidated/FairPoint, TDS, altafiber, Hawaiian Telcom, Alaska Communications, Ziply, Shentel, Lumos/North State, GoNetspeed/Otelco, Comporium, Hargray, Arvig, Golden West) are consolidated into single detailed entries. Added 92 competitive carriers that USAC lists as Lifeline home-voice providers plus restored rows (Totelcom TX; United Telephone Assn KS, United Telephone Mutual Aid ND, United Telephone Co TN) that an earlier name-regex had folded into other groups. Every U.S. state, DC, PR, GU, VI, AS and MP has at least one entry. Detailed tier (originally 78; 83 after review): 12 large ILECs, ~52 of the largest rural telcos/co-ops by USAC support (plus Claro PR and GTA Guam), home VoIP (Ooma, Vonage, magicJack) and captioned-phone services (CaptionCall, CapTel, ClearCaptions, InnoCaption - free, no bill). After review 81 of 83 detailed entries are verified; only Arvig (arvig.com bot challenge) and Ooma (Incapsula wall) remain verified=false. Completeness check: NTCA member list (300) - all U.S. ILEC members matched except a few non-ILEC affiliates/CLECs (Centranet OK, Foursight/Trilight TN, Cornerstone KY) and two Canadian members. Known gaps: (1) roster-tier rows have only name/website/phone from USAC (no billing links); about 170 have no website and 32 websites did not respond; (2) cable-company digital voice (Xfinity Voice, Spectrum Voice, Cox, Optimum, etc.) is billed with cable and is covered in cable-satellite-tv.json, not duplicated here; (3) wireless home-phone bases (Verizon Home Phone Connect, AT&T Wireless Home Phone) are billed as wireless; (4) other home-VoIP brands (e.g., 1-VoIP, VoIPLy, Axvoice, OBi/Google Voice; BasicTalk and Phone Power were added in review) and CLEC home-phone resellers were not enumerated - FCC Form 499 filer database is the source for a future pass; (5) Verizon's acquisition of Frontier has closed (frontier.com footer now '(c) 2026 Verizon'); Frontier billing is still on frontier.com but may migrate - recheck; (6) several USAC listings had wrong websites/phones (Pioneer Telephone Cooperative OR, Consolidated Telephone Co NE, Farmers Telephone Co IA, Peoples Telephone Co IA) and were nulled rather than guessed. REVIEWER PASS 2026-09-29: (a) Completeness: re-checked every USAC ILEC study-area code in rosters/telecom_providers.csv against this file; the 453 codes not named in notes all belong to grouped holding-company entries (TDS, Consolidated, Brightspeed, Frontier, Arvig, Comporium, Nuvera, REV, GoNetspeed, Ziply, Lumos, Alaska Communications, Hawaiian Telcom, Hargray), so no ILEC was missing. (b) Wrong same-name merges split: New Hope Tel Coop (VA vs AL), ITS Telecom FL vs Micronesian Telecom (MP), Citizens Tel Corp IN vs Citizens Tel Co GA, Glenwood GA vs Glenwood Network Services NE, Cambridge ID vs IL, Farmers Mutual MN vs OH, Sharon WI vs IA (7 new roster entries, websites left null). Farmers Independent (WI) support total corrected after the earlier SC split. (c) Duplicate rows merged (27 rows removed): Allamakee-Clayton (4), Skybeam (10), Big Bend Telecom Ltd (5), Federated, Midstate ND/SD, Dakota Central/Daktel, Silver Star ID/WY, Santa Rosa OK/TX, Valley Tel Coop NM/TX, Beehive NV/UT, WK&T KY/TN, Wolverton MN/ND, Oxford/Oxford West ME, Armstrong MD+NY/PA/WV. Star Telephone Co (LA) and Glenwood Telephone Membership Corp (NE) had another company's website/phone and were nulled. (d) Accuracy: every URL in detailed entries (~380) re-requested with curl (all resolve except bot-blocked arvig/hargray/vonage.com/Paymentus and two timeouts); ~45 entries had page content re-read. Fixed/added: Vonage (full rebuild from support.vonage.com: auto-charge, 1-800-528-7690 payment hotline, 1-732-944-0000), Hargray (now Sparklight help-center links, verified via Zendesk API), Shentel (autopay cancel text read in a browser), KPU (City of Ketchikan Paymentus portal), Comporium, Alaska Communications (Lifeline + AutoPay), Kinetic (Lifeline), altafiber (autopay cancel terms), Hawaiian Telcom (phone confirmed), Frontier (contact numbers), AT&T (redirected KM article), PTCI and RiverStreet (corrected customer-service numbers), HTC, SkyBest (mail address, pay by phone), HCTC (pay-by-phone 855-939-3624), Highland, Venture, Strata, Solarus, RTC, Triangle, Plateau, Reliance, ITC, Hiawatha. Phone numbers for 24 rural detailed entries were checked against the live pages (22 matched; 2 corrected). (e) Upgrades to detailed: SC Broadband (South Central Utah), Ponderosa (CA), Mountain Rural (KY), Northwest Communications Coop (ND); new detailed BasicTalk (Vonage budget home phone); new roster Phone Power. WebSearch was unavailable (session budget exhausted), so the review worked from official sites, sitemaps and USAC data. ROSTER BACKFILL 2026-09-30 (task roster-backfill-landline-telcos, edited in place; change log in roster-backfill-landline-telcos.json): (1) Websites: 64 of the 163 ILEC/telephone-co-op rows without a website now have one (50 fetched and matched this session; the rest are bot-walled or USAC-listed and marked verified=false). Discovery: cross-reference of every other category file and rosters/telecom_providers.csv (USAC study-area/Lifeline listings) by normalized name+state (state-regulator URLs such as iub.iowa.gov, mn.gov, psc.*, occeweb rejected), ~5,000 name-derived candidate domains resolved by DNS and fetched (accepted only when the page named the company and its town/state), and hand-checked brand changes (e.g., Knology->WOW!, Fidelity->Sparklight, Germantown->GTel/Archtop, Warwick Valley->WVT Fiber, Chester->Truvista, Stockholm-Strandburg->ITC, Westgate->WeavTel, Delta Communications->Clearwave, Skybeam->Rise). Rejected traps: farmtelcommunications.com and ctcn.net (hijacked/gambling or unrelated), delltelephone.com (placeholder blog), hamiltontelephone.com (disabled), citznet.com (Indiana CTC, not Citizens GA), starcom.net (NC, not Star Tel LA), farmerstel.net (MN, not Farmers Mutual OH), wescomm.com (radio dealer), etstelco.com (ID/UT ISP, not ETS Tel TX), citizens.coop (VA). Still without a website: 99 ({'private': 82, 'cooperative': 17}); top states {'IA': 24, 'IL': 8, 'MN': 5, 'NE': 5, 'OH': 4, 'OK': 4, 'OR': 4, 'TX': 4}. Most are very small Iowa/Illinois/Ohio/Minnesota mutuals and hotel/resort telcos (Bretton Woods, Dixville NH) that publish no site, or whose USAC-listed domain no longer resolves (Electra TX, Tatum TX, Skyline UT/WA, Manawa WI, Moultrie IL, Wyandotte OK ark-o.net, Roome OR ritnet.com for sale). NTCA member directory and state association sites (Iowa Communications Alliance, OTA, MTA, etc.) were blocked or unreachable from this session and could not be used. (2) Detail upgrades: 152 rows moved roster->detailed. 82 reuse the verified links of the same company's detailed entry in internet-rural-coops.json (noted per row; URLs re-checked HTTP 200 2026-10-02, otherwise verified=false). 70 were researched by hand from the companies' own sites, chosen from the largest USAC high-cost recipients not yet detailed plus those named in the brief (Totelcom, West Central MN, Chickasaw-not reachable, GCI/AP&T/ASTAC/OTZ/Cordova/Bristol Bay/Nushagak/Copper Valley/UUI in Alaska): includes WCVT, WK&T, DRN, Wiktel, MTE, Pine, Michigan Broadband (UPTC), Franklin MS, ATC ID, SW Texas, Green Hills, WTC Fiber, Volcano, Hart, Siskiyou, CC Communications, CentraCom, United TN, Totelcom, Northern MT, GBT, Nortex, Poka Lambro, Totah, Table Top, Midstate SD, Sebastian, Mosaic/Chibardun, Fidelity/Sparklight, GCI, Dobson, WCTA, Cap Rock, Union WY, Lightcurve/Mashell, CLtel, NATCO, Blue Valley, NVC, Darien, Bevcomm, Lakeland, FMTC ID, BTC KY, five TEC divisions, Bluepeak/Clarity. For 11 large co-ops whose own sites sit behind SiteGround/Cloudflare bot challenges (Smithville, Public Service GA, AP&T, Btel, PSC Fiber, ASTAC, Bulloch, WesTex, Peoples TX, RTC IN, Madison IL) the NISC SmartHub portal was identified directly via its public site-name endpoint and linked, and for 3 more (NCTC TN, Shawnee IL, Garden Valley MN) the Innovative Systems eBill/eStatement portal was found on the company's billing subdomain (page footer names company/address/phone); their company help/Lifeline pages remain unread. Detailed now 235 of 1015 (208 verified). Not upgraded (bot-walled sites, no readable billing pages): Western New Mexico Telephone, Oregon Telephone Corp, Chickasaw Telephone (chickasawphone.com refuses connections), LTC Connect KY, Ellijay GA, Twin Valley KS, Santel SD, TelAlaska, TCT West WY, Brandenburg KY (rate-limited), Haviland KS, InterBel MT, Highline/Rye CO, Winnebago Coop IA (eStatement portal linked) - these keep roster tier with whatever pay/login links were found. NTS (Texas) is not an ILEC row in this file. Guam GTA and Claro PR were already detailed; IT&E (CNMI) website added but not readable. || REVIEWER PASS 2026-10-02 (second, skeptical pass on landline-telcos.json): Accuracy - all ~1,080 distinct URLs on detailed entries were requested by curl (936 HTTP 200 on the first pass; the 71 failures were retried one at a time, and most were slow pages or bot walls rather than dead links). 40+ entries' billing pages were then read in full and fixed as needed. Pages read: Nex-Tech, Moundridge, Scott County Tel Coop VA, Evertek, KanOkla, Sacred Wind, Bolt Fiber, DTC, All West, Home Telecom SC, Golden West, Range, HTC, GTA, Pioneer OK, Ben Lomand, Pioneer Connect OR, 3 Rivers, Highland TN, Dobson, GCI, Volcano, CentraCom, Nortex, Poka Lambro, WCVT, Empower, Colorado Valley, Syntrio, ptci.net, Arvig's My Arvig portal and Direct Communications. Errors fixed: (a) 'SCTC' (Arkansas, SAC 403031) had been given the links and phones of Scott County Telephone Cooperative (Virginia) through a USAC listing mismatch, so it was renamed Scott County Telephone Company (Waldron AR) and set back to roster. (b) Panhandle Telephone Cooperative (OK) had absorbed the Oregon Pioneer Telephone Cooperative study area through USAC's wrong ptci.net listing. That study area is now its own detailed entry, 'Pioneer Connect' (pioneer.net, SmartHub, pay-by-phone, Oregon Lifeline). (c) The 'Twin Valley' row for Southern Kansas Telephone was renamed SKT. (d) Duplicate 'Fremont Telecom - RoR' (ID) was merged into Blackfoot, because FCC 477 lists Fremont Telcom as DBA Blackfoot. (e) The 3 Rivers website was moved to the apex domain because www has a TLS certificate mismatch. (f) Empower, Home Telecom, All West and CentraCom phones were corrected. (g) Highland's published webpay.highlandtel.net did not resolve in DNS (noted). Gap fills: autopay_cancel was filled on 51 detailed entries by reusing the autopay_setup URL, each with a note saying autopay is stopped in the same portal or by phone. Ooma, Vonage and BasicTalk are left null because they charge a card on file. SmartHub portals were used for statements_history on 11 entries and paperless on 31, with notes. 42 detailed ILECs that had no company assistance page now link the national Lifeline site, lifelinesupport.org. Arvig now has its My Arvig portal. Payment processors were added where pages showed them (Authorize.net/Dobson, Paymentus, PayDQ, SmartHub). Completeness: every USAC ILEC study area in rosters/telecom_providers.csv was checked against this file by SAC. The 453 SACs not cited are all subsidiaries of holding companies that already have an entry (AT&T/Bell, Brightspeed, TDS, Consolidated, Windstream, Alaska Communications, Lumos/North State, REV/Lafourche, GoNetspeed/Otelco/Ontario, Ziply). So no ILEC billers were missing. FCC Form 477 holding-company DBA data resolved the parent or billing home of 16 roster rows that had no website. Examples: Star Tel LA is Direct Communications Louisiana; North Texas Tel is part of Totelcom/Oklatel/NTT SmartHub; Oklahoma Western belongs to Hilliary; New London and Stoutland MO belong to Oregon Telephone Corp/Rally Networks; Moultrie belongs to Shawnee; Rothsay belongs to Park Region; Wolverton belongs to Polar; South Canaan belongs to LHTC; Chugwater belongs to Mountain West Technologies. Websites inferred only from ownership are marked verified=false. Totals: entries 1014, detailed 235 (221 verified), roster 779, still without website 90 (mostly tiny IA/IL/OH/MN mutuals). Still open: Chickasaw Tel (OK) and Twin Valley KS sites refuse automated connections. The arvig.com, nex-tech pages, GRM www2, farmerstel.com and Cloudflare-protected co-op help pages could not be read. Concord Tel Exchange (TN) is believed to be TDS but this was not confirmed. The NTCA member directory and state associations were not reachable. This session's WebSearch budget was exhausted, so discovery relied on curl, WebFetch and the rosters.
